bull.t: Accelerating product revenue growth and upgraded guidance
bull.b: Sustained acceleration in product revenue and a higher FY guide reflect deeper platform adoption and expanding enterprise consumption. Durable top-line strength increases revenue visibility, supports reinvestment in product & go-to-market, and underpins multi-year growth potential across data and AI workloads.

bull.t: Strong operating cash flow and free cash flow generation
bull.b: Robust free cash flow despite GAAP losses shows the consumption model converts to real cash, providing funding for R&D, buybacks, and debt servicing. Durable cash generation improves optionality, reduces dependency on capital markets, and supports strategic investments over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Strategic partnerships and native AI product traction
bull.b: Large cloud and AI partnerships expand distribution, lower infrastructure costs, and validate Snowflake as a control plane for enterprise AI. Native AI adoption and partner deals strengthen customer stickiness and upsell pathways, creating a durable competitive moat around data-to-AI workflows.

bear.b: Material negative net margins and ongoing GAAP losses reflect operating expense intensity and limit accounting profitability. Over the medium term this constrains return metrics, increases sensitivity to margin pressure, and prolongs reliance on cash flow and/or capital to fund growth investments.

bear.t: Rising leverage on the balance sheet
bear.b: A marked increase in debt-to-equity while losses persist raises financial flexibility risk. Higher leverage adds interest and refinancing exposure, constrains ability to pursue M&A or aggressive investment, and amplifies downside if revenue or cash generation slows over the next several quarters.

bear.t: AI gross-margin pressure and scaling execution risk
bear.b: Native AI consumption can be materially more costly than core workloads; scaling these uses may compress gross margins unless offsets (cloud discounts, efficiency) scale faster. Combined with rapid adoption and limited organic hiring, execution and margin dilution risk could persist across upcoming quarters.
